# Test bd dep error cases

bd init --prefix test

bd create 'First issue'
cp stdout first.txt
exec sh -c 'grep -oE "test-[a-z0-9]+" first.txt > first_id.txt'

# Add dependency with nonexistent blocker should fail.
# The target keeps the fixture's own prefix (test): a plain cross-prefix
# target is accepted as an external reference, so it would not fail here.
! exec sh -c 'bd dep add $(cat first_id.txt) test-nonexistent'
stderr 'no issue found'

# Add self-dependency should fail
! exec sh -c 'bd dep add $(cat first_id.txt) $(cat first_id.txt)'
stderr 'cannot depend on itself'

# dep tree on nonexistent issue should fail
! bd dep tree nonexistent-id
stderr 'no issue found'
